name: std/numerics
description: Advanced / special functions over the std/math number types: cube root, error/gamma functions, real & complex series, rational/real/integer numeric routines.
residual: BLOCKER (needs a code edit to vendored source — user decision): DataErrors (the numeric error/warning reporter these 9 modules share) IMPORTs Beep, and Unix Beep pulls X11/Displays/XDisplay. So as written, all advanced math transitively drags the display stack. RECOMMENDED FIX: cut the beep-on-error calls in DataErrors.Mod (lines ~313-330) and its Beep import — replace the audible warning with a KernelLog/Trace message. Until then std/numerics cannot go stable and would need a display-driver dependency, which is wrong for a math package.
MathMitLef and Shortreal were also excluded from std/math: MathMitLef -> CalcGauss (std/calc); Shortreal -> FoxArrayBase (std/compiler). Re-home during the calc/compiler passes.
